Map: Transmitter release and mast cell activation
Why: transmitters released from nociceptors activate mast cells and carry nociceptive signals
Note: Substance P activates human OA synovial mast cells through MRGPRX2; CGRP in the joint sensitises joint nociceptors in OA rats, and joint BDNF maintains OA pain.
Evidence: human OA synovial cells and OA models (rat)
